text: Allah bears witness that He alone is worthy of divinity, and He coupled His testimony with the testimony of the angels and the people of knowledge, upon the most noble subject of testimony, which is His oneness and His establishment of justice; there is no god but Him, the Almighty, from whom nothing He wills is withheld, the Wise in His words and deeds.
